title: Refund on a Cancelled Alignment Plan — Alignment Services & Plans Settlement Statement
content:
**Settlement statement — refund of a cancelled Alignment Services & Plans plan.**

The refund starts from the plan's purchase price. Each alignment already performed on the plan and booked as included in the plan, the purchase-day alignment included, is deducted at the line's deduction per included alignment. A processing fee is deducted by the plan's cancellation age, the calendar days from the purchase date to the cancellation date:

| Cancellation age | Processing fee |
|---|---|
| at least 21 days | 20.00 |
| at least 11 days and below 21 days | 10.00 |
| below 11 days | 0.00 |

The labor and parts charges of the plan's alignment work orders dated the cancellation day are open on that day's ticket and are settled from the refund. The refund is the purchase price less the deductions, the processing fee and those open charges, rounded to the nearest cent and never below 0.00. The deduction per included alignment is the figure for the plan's line on the product's cancellation schedule.

### Statement worked through (hypothetical plan; figures chosen for illustration)
| Line of the statement | Amount |
|---|---|
| Purchase price | 200.00 |
| Included alignments performed: 1, at an illustrative deduction of 100.00 | less 100.00 |
| Cancellation age 15 days | less 10.00 |
| Open charges of work orders dated the cancellation day: labor 12.00, parts 8.00 | less 20.00 |
| Refund | 70.00 |

With a cancellation age of 10 days the fee line would read 0.00 and the refund 80.00; at 21 days it would read 20.00 and the refund 60.00. Had the deductions and charges exceeded the purchase price, the refund would be 0.00.
